logp.method_description: The n-octanol-water partition coefficients of the complexes were determined as previously reported [62] using a shake-flask method. PBS buffered distilled water (100 mL, phosphate buffer  = 10 mM, [NaCl] = 0.15 M, pH 7.4) and n-octanol (100 mL) were saturated for 72 h. 1 mg of the complexes was mixed in 1 mL of aqueous and organic phase, respectively for 10 min. The resultant emulsion was centrifuged to separate the phases. The concentration of the compound in each phase was determined using UV absorbance spectroscopy. Log D7.4 was defined as log{[compound(organic)]/[compound(aqueous)]}.
